# Webhook Management

Generate an inbound webhook URL per dataflow (a GET that writes) and receive webhook posts.

2 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

## Operations

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/v{version}/Webhook/generate/{dataflowId}`](#op-webhook-generatewebhookurl) | Webhook_GenerateWebhookUrl |
| POST | [`/api/v{version}/Webhook/{dataflowId}/{webhookId}`](#op-webhook-receivewebhook) | Webhook_ReceiveWebhook |

<a id="op-webhook-generatewebhookurl"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/Webhook/generate/{dataflowId}`

operationId `Webhook_GenerateWebhookUrl` · Generates a unique webhook URL for a specific dataflow to receive external data

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataflowId` | path | int64 | yes | The unique identifier of the dataflow that will receive webhook data |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfCreateWebhookResponse](#schema-resultofcreatewebhookresponse) | Webhook URL generated successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Invalid dataflow ID |
| `404` | [Result](#schema-result) | Dataflow not found |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error during URL generation |

<a id="op-webhook-receivewebhook"></a>
### POST `/api/v{version}/Webhook/{dataflowId}/{webhookId}`

operationId `Webhook_ReceiveWebhook` · Receives webhook data from external systems and stores it for processing by the specified dataflow

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataflowId` | path | int64 | yes | The unique identifier of the target dataflow |
| `webhookId` | path | string | yes | The unique identifier of the webhook endpoint |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body `body` (application/json), **required**: any

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfBoolean](#schema-resultofboolean) | Webhook data received and stored successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Unauthorized webhook URL or invalid data format |
| `404` | [Result](#schema-result) | Webhook endpoint not found |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error during data processing |
